{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "heavy_halogen_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of heavy halogen-like substructure counts (V3 Cl-like, V4 Br-like, V11 F-like) often resistant to biodegradation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 40.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree splits on cumulative halogenation can separate persistent compounds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 + V4 + V11"
    },
    {
      "name": "aromatic_ring_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite index of aromatic/ring descriptors combining V16 and V41 counts with V8 percent property.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 120.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures aromatic load which strongly affects biodegradability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V16 + V41 + V8 / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "nitrogen_oxygen_functional_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Total count of N/O containing functional group descriptors (V5,V6,V7,V9,V10).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Polar functional group load is a strong determinant of biodegradation pathways.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V5 + V6 + V7 + V9 + V10"
    },
    {
      "name": "has_any_rare_substructure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator: presence of any rare substructure flags V19, V24, V29.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "boolean_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single split captures presence of unusual moieties.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((V19 + V24 + V29) > 0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_size_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of V39 (molecular size descriptor): 0 small, 1 medium, 2 large, 3 very large.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_bucket",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discrete size tier for tree thresholds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V39 < 7.5, 0, np.where(V39 < 8.5, 1, np.where(V39 < 9.5, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "lipophilicity_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proxy for lipophilicity combining V1 and V13 (log-like descriptors) minus polar V12.",
      "value_range": [-10.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Lipophilic vs hydrophilic balance strongly informs degradation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 + V13 - V12"
    },
    {
      "name": "halogen_to_size_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Halogen substituent density per molecular size unit.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Density of halogens relative to size highlights heavily substituted small molecules.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V3 + V4 + V11) / (V39 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "topology_complexity_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Topological complexity from V14, V15, V36, V37 descriptors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 40.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combined topology metric for split efficiency.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V14 + V15 + V36 + V37"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_v30_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that V30 exceeds the typical range (>20), capturing extreme values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "boolean_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct boolean split for outlier descriptor V30.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V30 > 20.0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v17_v18_v22_shape_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction of normalized shape descriptors V17, V18, V22.",
      "value_range": [0.5, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures joint shape-index region that single features miss.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V17 * V18 * V22"
    },
    {
      "name": "functional_diversity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic count of distinct non-zero functional/substructure descriptors among V3-V11, V19-V26, V29, V32-V35, V38, V40, V41 indicating molecular diversity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_diversity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree can split on diversity to distinguish simple vs complex molecules.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "persistent_pollutant_likelihood",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Heuristic ordinal score (0-4) judging persistence: high heavy-halogen count, high aromatic load, low polar group ratio, and large size jointly indicate likely persistent/non-degradable structure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_chemistry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain prior into a single ordinal that trees can split cleanly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
